verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Gitea can reuse existing GitHub Actions fetched from any Git website, and it lists external tools such as Drone, Jenkins and Argo CD as integrations. None of it documents a marketplace or app directory for browsing and installing third-party integrations. Pulling actions by repository reference and connecting outside CI tools are adjacent features, not an installable app directory, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install third-party integrations from a marketplace or app directory
